rule: R1 Keep flagged fixtures IN the primary aggregate. No flagged fixture carries a mechanism claim. No fixture is excluded (excluded_from_primary_aggregate stays empty).

R2 Pre-registered leave-flagged-out sensitivity: every primary statistic, screen and reading is recomputed without the in-session flagged fixtures and reported beside the primary, never instead of it. The direction screen then uses ceil(0.75 x n) of the n remaining fixtures.

R3 Fixture flags are counted by position as well as by layer-unit: a gross position is a (fixture, pool) gross in at least one DSA layer of either rank. The attempt-2 definitions (outside own null: gross_f > max(2 x max(N_dd_f, N_pp_f), 0.1 %) with >= 10 gross units; arm asymmetry between the two clean runs C1, C2 on the units both share with N_pp) are evaluated twice, once with layer-units and once with positions as the unit (>= 3 gross positions replacing >= 10 gross units). Both counts are reported; a flag on either count marks the fixture flagged. [A22-3] N_dd = C1 vs C2, N_pp = LW1 vs LW2 (different build length), matched by fixture x layer x shared causal pool.
R4 (not applicable after A22-7) be2e9e349395's 13 three-way-reproducible gross units (known_fragile_be2e9e349395.json) would be a known fragile set in stratum S, which is omitted.

R5 In-session flags on the long fixtures (GATE-1, C1 and C2 against the LW1 prefill reference) follow R1-R3: the fixture stays in the primary aggregate, carries no mechanism claim, and is dropped in the R2 sensitivity.
A22_7: Short stratum S is omitted (amendment 22 item 7). be2e9e349395 and 376073921446 are attempt-2 short traces of the S set and therefore do not enter this contrast; R4's known fragile set has nothing to act on and is kept only for a later labelled exploratory short-context comparison, after the first-contrast definitions are frozen.
